cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

mechanism: A warmly recasts B caution as qualification, then gives precise packing instructions that remove both task choice and proposed shared work.
confusable: D53 forces unwanted duties through hierarchy; D69 uses sustained appreciation while narrowing actual options.
comparison: Reunion alternative removes backup location; moving alternative withdraws books choice then joint packing option.
seedUse: Books/plates choice, china anxiety, wrapping proposal and A downstairs move derive from D69-b; S03 adds actual packing sequence corrections.
